title: Ensure PostgreSQL subdirectory locations are outside the data cluster
rationale: Separating WAL, backup, and archive directories from the primary data directory improves resilience, simplifies recovery, and reduces the risk of data loss due to a single storage failure.
remediation: Review the PostgreSQL directory layout and ensure WAL archives, backups, and other supporting directories reside on separate storage from the main data directory where practical.

title: Ensure the backup and restore tool, pgBackRest, is installed and configured
rationale: A reliable backup solution is essential for disaster recovery and point-in-time recovery operations.
remediation: Install pgBackRest, configure a repository, validate scheduled backups, and periodically test restore procedures.

title: Ensure miscellaneous configuration settings are correct
rationale: Backup retention, verification, scheduling, and recovery procedures should be reviewed regularly to ensure successful recovery when needed.
remediation: Review backup schedules, retention policies, restore testing procedures, monitoring, and documentation to ensure they meet organizational recovery objectives.
